label: Conditional consequences, each assuming what it states
meaning: Conditional consequences, each assuming what it states. Under a classification of respects counted only formally, an esse-cause of a thing with a classified respect has that respect formally, including under the classification that something else has it formally and is not composite. The five structural premises and a maximum give that the maximum is not composite, not matter-form, and no component; with ST I q.14 a.1 it has intellect, and with q.19 a.1 will. With excluded middle and Papineau's three premises, the third distributive, an occurrence of the target kind on a noncomposite bearer is inconsistent with composite physical bearers and same-bearer realizers. Worlds that swap an outcome, with base-fixed favouring, net selection at both, and a base of state facts, differ in state; a state that differs at an accessible world is a contingent fact; a reason-closed founded account of a contingent state fact does not have all its reasons contingent. The conceivability test with its extension to the deity excludes both, given the premise for the material world. A necessary being gives that each accessible world has an existent. This establishes no premise, and it does not say a necessary being is a maximum, simple, unique, or God.
